name: Return and Refund
description: Customer needs help processing a return for a defective item.
opening_message: Hi, I need help with a return. My order arrived damaged.
success_criteria: Customer is told how to initiate the return
Customer feels their issue was taken seriously

name: Pre-Purchase Inquiry
description: Customer asks questions to decide whether to make a purchase.
opening_message: Hi, I'm thinking about buying some wireless headphones. Can you help?
success_criteria: Customer gets product recommendations within their budget
Customer understands warranty and return policy
Customer has enough information to make a decision
